scope: Targeted runtime audit; not an H05 benchmark or replacement for historical baselines

input.description: One resident upload before measurement, fresh membership build per iteration; every key in and just outside the domain checked on GPU and compared with the CPU formula after timing. No dedup/join/materialization time is included in build_ms.

before.implementation: Original serial membership_bounds; elapsed synchronizes after each operation

after.implementation: Sound loader domain initializes bounds without a scan; bounded parallel extrema fallback for conservative domains exceeding budget; event collection only at finish

profile.scope: Memcpy counts cover each status initialize_count through membership_insert completion; full process additionally includes initial loader transfers, explicit probe answer downloads and status reads. Event synchronization calls from CudaEvent::elapsed_ms occur at finish after stream synchronization, not during stage submission. Profile timings are separate from unprofiled samples.

correctness.original_count_owner_repro: runtime-oracle panicked: escaped encoded column lost its count owner
correctness.original_empty_derived_run_repro: runtime-oracle --bounds returned CQ_GPU_RUN_DOMAIN: dense rank domain exceeds 2^32 key positions
correctness.runtime_oracle: passed escaped-column ownership, resident indexed output, empty/negative bounds, conservative-domain reduction, empty/full-width membership domain errors and compressed capacity error propagation

h05_resident_smoke.scope: Correctness smoke with all six resident relations, packed answer -> compiled identity -> explicit download. Another host build was active; do not treat these smoke timings as a new performance baseline.
